summary: Canada Lookouts lists Rennie among Manitoba lookouts, but its page carries only the name; no other source was found.

evidence.supports: the page carries only the name
Manitoba towers once common, most since removed
evidence.quote: Fire lookout towers were once commonly used to watch for forest fires in Manitoba but most of them have been removed.

sources.title: Sasaginnigak Fire Tower (Sasaginnigak Lake, Atikaki Provincial Park), Historic Sites of Manitoba

notes_for_editor: The story is deliberately below the 120-word floor: the only source for Rennie is a Canada Lookouts page with the name and no text, and no source gives a build date, staffing, fate or access. The Manitoba Historical Society sentence is general context about Manitoba towers, not about Rennie. The record's point (49.852, -95.538) is the author's Weebly map placement; no source checked it. No NHLR or FFLOS entry was found for Manitoba. Editor may prefer to hold this as a stub.
